strategy.name: intraday_dynamic_independent_sma_period_cross_locked_2016_2026
strategy.description: 把 TIM-v0.50 在2000-2015探索期机械选出的历史诊断锚点完整冻结为 c=3%、d关闭、买入SMA310、卖出SMA190，并从2016年第一个交易日起以独立空仓状态运行到批准数据末日。另运行买入SMA270-350与卖出SMA150-230、步长10的81组预登记局部扰动，但这些扰动只描述锚点附近的稳定性，禁止根据2016年后的结果替换310/190。
strategy.buy_rule: 空仓时，若前一完成 Close <= 前一完成买入SMA，则在开盘前放置向上普通买单，动态价为 P=sum(previous buy_window-1 closes)/(buy_window-1)。若已有卖出，同时放置上次计成本卖出成交价×1.03的强制买回线；两条向上触发线取较低者优先。锁定锚点的买入SMA为310，扰动诊断为270至350、步长10。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时，若前一完成 Close >= 前一完成卖出SMA，则在开盘前放置向下普通卖单，动态价为 P=sum(previous sell_window-1 closes)/(sell_window-1)。d完全关闭，不放置成本止损或其他强制卖出线。锁定锚点的卖出SMA为190，扰动诊断为150至230、步长10。
strategy.signal_time: 每个常规交易日开盘前，只使用截至前一交易日 Close 的完成历史、前一完成SMA状态和既有实际账户成交价，冻结当日资格与触发价；2016年前数据只用于均线预热，窗口前禁止交易。
strategy.execution_time: 若常规时段 Open 已越过预挂触发线则按 Open 成交；否则调整后日线 OHLC 触及时按精确理论线成交；随后施加单边5 bps不利成本。每日最多一笔，不允许买入后同日卖出或卖出后同日买回。
strategy.positioning: long-only；2016-01-04以100,000美元现金独立空仓开始；每次买入投入全部现金、每次卖出清空全部份额；允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.price_basis: approved split-and-dividend-adjusted QQQ OHLC; an internally consistent total-return approximation, not an exact raw-price corporate-action account replay

parameters.warmup_policy: Use approved QQQ history before 2016 only to complete all prior SMA and provisional-cross inputs. Start every case flat with 100,000 USD on 2016-01-04 and never inherit the parent run's position, cash, cost basis or sell anchor.

locked_anchor.selection_policy: This is the sole locked test case. It was fixed from TIM-v0.50 before any 2016+ result is read and cannot be replaced by a perturbation winner.

parameters.legacy_symbol_mapping: forced_rebuy_pct is prior c; stop_loss_pct is prior d
parameters.subperiod_state_policy: Run one continuous path from the common flat start. At fixed subperiod boundaries inherit the actual position and sell anchor, rebase equity at the boundary and never restart or peek.

identifiability_gate.scope: descriptive robustness only; it cannot select or replace the locked anchor

perturbation_protocol.full_surface: All 9x9 combinations are evaluated and reconciled. Report four metric heatmaps and distribution summaries without ranking a replacement.
perturbation_protocol.buy_oat: Hold sell_window=190 and inspect buy_window=270..350 step10.
perturbation_protocol.sell_oat: Hold buy_window=310 and inspect sell_window=150..230 step10.
perturbation_protocol.local_3x3: buy_window in 300/310/320 crossed with sell_window in 180/190/200.

predeclared_diagnostic_gates.interpretation: Passing both gates supports local out-of-sample stability only. It does not promote the strategy because the parent exploratory search failed its PBO and DSR gates.

formal_reconciliation.requirement: Every case must match both independently structured compiled ledgers and then match PyBroker plus the independent Python ledger in dates, sides, shares, fills, cash and equity within 1e-6.

parameters.multiple_testing_policy: Do not compute or use PBO/DSR to select among the 81 holdout perturbations. The only inferential case is the pre-locked 310/190 anchor; all other rows are descriptive sensitivity evidence.

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: Invest the same 100,000 USD at the 2016-01-04 regular-session Open with 5 bps adverse entry cost and hold QQQ through 2026-08-04.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v4 unchanged. Add locked-anchor performance, 9x9 metric heatmaps, two one-at-a-time slices, local-neighborhood diagnostics, inherited-state subperiods and the anchor market chart.

research.hypothesis: The pre-2016 diagnostic anchor c=3%, d disabled, buy-SMA310/sell-SMA190 retains useful risk-adjusted performance on untouched 2016+ QQQ data and sits inside a locally stable buy/sell-period neighborhood rather than an isolated historical spike.
research.primary_metric: The locked 310/190 anchor's complete-window CAGR, Sharpe and maximum drawdown versus identical-window QQQ Buy & Hold. The 81-case surface cannot change the primary case.
research.selection_rule: None. Evaluate 310/190 as the only locked anchor. The other 80 combinations are predeclared perturbations for diagnostics only; do not call the best 2016-2026 row a selected, promoted or recommended parameter.
research.validation_plan: Save all 81 complete-window and fixed-subperiod metrics, all orders/trades/daily states and the complete 9x9 surface. Require exact agreement between two compiled ledgers and formal PyBroker/Python reconciliation for all 81 cases, plus hashes, unit tests, catalog rebuild, workspace audit and real-browser report checks.
research.promotion_criteria: No strategy promotion is authorized by this experiment. If the locked anchor passes the predeclared benchmark-effectiveness gate and its local 3x3 passes every stability gate, record supportive out-of-sample evidence while retaining the parent PBO/DSR failure as a blocking caveat.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject the run if 310/190 or c=3/d关闭 changes, any perturbation replaces the anchor, any pre-2016 trade or inherited parent state occurs, the 81-case grid is incomplete, subperiods overlap or leave gaps, data is unapproved, a case trades more than once per day, strategy/benchmark windows differ, ledgers diverge, or any hash, test, audit, catalog, strategy-card or browser gate fails. A completed run may provide unfavorable evidence without being an engineering failure.
